label: KRT5+ ectopic pod area / damaged alveolar area
reference: Lin et al. J Clin Invest 2024;134(19):e176828 (measured by hand with outline splines)

denominator.semantics: In the LEFT@damaged scope, region_area_um2 is the DAMAGED alveolar area only. aggregate_tiles_to_slide.py:276-284 sums only the damaged rows into the slide row, so the damaged area is already the denominator by the time aggregate_to_mouse.py sees it.

audit_rule: abs(numerator/denominator - KRT5_pod_area_frac) < 1e-9. If this fails, the pooled totals and the recomputed fraction disagree and neither may be reported.

pooling.rule: SUM numerator across all rows of a mouse, SUM denominator across all rows of a mouse, THEN divide.
pooling.never: Do not average per-tile or per-slide pod fractions. Tiles differ in damaged area by more than an order of magnitude; an unweighted mean is a different quantity.

detection_floor.basis: false-positive KRT5 area fraction in INTACT control parenchyma at threshold 500; no threshold reaches 1e-4
detection_floor.rule: An effect smaller than this floor is not distinguishable from KRT5 background and must not be reported as a difference.

guards: The denominator must be non-zero. A mouse with zero damaged area yields 0.0 by construction (aggregate_to_mouse.py:330) and must be excluded by hand, not silently averaged in as a zero.

KRT5_pod_area_frac_of_intact (aggregate_tiles_to_slide.py:303) is the QC counterpart: dysplastic pods belong in damaged parenchyma. A large intact value means the damage mask, the KRT5 threshold, or both are wrong. NOTE: that column is currently DROPPED at mouse level because its name matches no sum_cols pattern -- see MODULE_CONTRACT.md section 3.3.
